risks.title: Feedstock supply shortfall
risks.description: Insufficient biomass feedstock availability due to competing users, seasonal shortage, or crop failure
risks.early_warning_signals: Feedstock supply study shows < 70% coverage; supplier HoT not signed by Phase 1 gate
risks.mitigation: Secure multiple feedstock sources; maintain 3-month strategic stockpile
risks.contingency: Alternative feedstock sourcing from wider radius; partial plant turndown

risks.title: Feedstock moisture consistently above 30%
risks.description: High moisture content reduces gasifier efficiency, increases oxygen demand, and raises energy costs
risks.early_warning_signals: Average moisture > 25% in received loads; drying system at capacity
risks.mitigation: Specify moisture maximum in supply contracts; install covered storage; design robust drying system
risks.contingency: Supplementary drying capacity; blend wet with dry feedstock

risks.title: Ash-related slagging/fouling in gasifier
risks.description: Ash composition leads to slagging or fouling in gasifier, reducing availability and damaging refractory
risks.early_warning_signals: Ash fusion temperature approaching gasifier operating temperature; pressure drop increase across gasifier
risks.mitigation: Blend feedstocks to control ash chemistry; design for feedstock flexibility
risks.contingency: Planned maintenance every 6 months; refractory replacement spare in inventory

risks.title: Tar formation exceeding cleanup capacity
risks.description: Tar concentration in raw syngas exceeds syngas cleanup system design capacity, causing fouling in downstream equipment
risks.early_warning_signals: Tar sampling upstream of scrubber showing increasing trend; pressure drop across cleanup increasing
risks.mitigation: Design primary and secondary tar removal with 20% margin; select gasifier type with lower tar yield
risks.contingency: Additional polishing step; reduced throughput to lower tar load

risks.title: Gasifier vendor delivery delay
risks.description: Long-lead gasifier equipment delivered after contractual date, pushing back overall schedule
risks.early_warning_signals: Vendor progress reports behind schedule; manufacturing milestones not met
risks.mitigation: Vendor qualification with proven track record; liquidated damages in contract; regular shop inspections
risks.contingency: Expedite shipping; adjust construction sequence to prioritise downstream work

risks.title: Gasifier refractory failure
risks.description: Refractory lining fails prematurely due to thermal cycling, slag attack, or manufacturing defect
risks.early_warning_signals: Hot spots on gasifier shell; refractory thermocouple readings exceeding limits
risks.mitigation: Select refractory grade suitable for biomass ash chemistry; follow strict dry-out and heat-up procedures
risks.contingency: Spare refractory modules; emergency repair contractor on standby

risks.title: Syngas cleanup system underperforms
risks.description: Syngas cleanup (tar, S, Cl, metals removal) does not achieve the required outlet specifications
risks.early_warning_signals: Performance test results showing above-spec contaminants; guard bed breakthrough detected early
risks.mitigation: Include performance guarantees in licensor contract; design with redundant polishing steps
risks.contingency: Additional guard bed capacity; temporary chemical dosing; reduced catalyst activity acceptance

risks.title: Sulphur removal fails to meet catalyst spec
risks.description: H2S/COS concentration after acid gas removal exceeds 0.1 ppmv, poisoning methanol catalyst
risks.early_warning_signals: H2S analyser showing above limit; guard bed breakthrough curve steepening
risks.mitigation: Design AGR with margin; install online H2S analyser; use guard bed with colorimetric indicator
risks.contingency: Replace guard bed sorbent; shut down and replace catalyst if poisoned

risks.title: Chlorine in syngas exceeds cleanup capability
risks.description: Chlorine from biomass passes through cleanup, reaching methanol catalyst and causing deactivation
risks.early_warning_signals: Feedstock analysis showing Cl > 0.1 wt%; HCl analyser after cleanup trending up
risks.mitigation: Feedstock specification limiting chlorine; chlorine guard bed in cleanup train
risks.contingency: Sodium bicarbonate injection for HCl control; earlier catalyst replacement cycle

risks.title: H2/CO ratio suboptimal for methanol synthesis
risks.description: Syngas ratio cannot be adjusted to target stoichiometry, reducing methanol conversion efficiency
risks.early_warning_signals: Process simulation showing SN < 1.8 or > 2.2 at design conditions; WGS reactor undersized
risks.mitigation: Design WGS with turndown flexibility; include CO2 removal and optional H2 make-up
risks.contingency: Accept lower conversion with increased recycle; external H2 supply agreement

risks.title: CO2 removal system underperforms
risks.description: CO2 removal (amine or membrane) does not achieve required CO2 slip spec, affecting methanol reactor equilibrium
risks.early_warning_signals: CO2 analyser after removal showing increasing trend; solvent degradation in amine system
risks.mitigation: Design with margin; regular solvent quality monitoring; solvent reclaimer
risks.contingency: Increase recycle ratio; accept lower methanol yield

risks.title: Methanol catalyst deactivation
risks.description: Cu/ZnO/Al2O3 catalyst deactivates faster than expected due to poisoning, thermal sintering, or mechanical attrition
risks.early_warning_signals: Increasing reactor temperature requirement to maintain conversion; by-product formation increasing
risks.mitigation: Strict syngas impurity control; proper catalyst reduction procedure; avoid thermal excursions
risks.contingency: Catalyst replacement (3-4 week shutdown); adjust temperature to compensate temporarily

risks.title: Methanol reactor hot spot formation
risks.description: Localised hot spots in methanol synthesis reactor due to maldistribution, channeling, or catalyst degradation
risks.early_warning_signals: Temperature spread across bed exceeding 20°C; multiple thermocouples showing divergent readings
risks.mitigation: Design with quench or inter-bed cooling; follow catalyst loading procedure precisely
risks.contingency: Shutdown for catalyst inspection and replacement if confirmed

risks.title: Distillation product quality failure
risks.description: Product methanol fails to meet IMPCA specification (purity, ethanol, acetone, propanol) even after optimisation
risks.early_warning_signals: Lab analysis showing impurity trend approaching spec limit; column pressure/temperature unstable
risks.mitigation: Design with flexibility for three-column distillation; inline GC analyser; product blending option
risks.contingency: Two-column to three-column upgrade; reprocess to recycle

risks.title: Catalyst procurement delay
risks.description: Methanol synthesis catalyst not delivered in time for loading, pushing back commissioning schedule
risks.early_warning_signals: Catalyst order not placed >12 months before planned loading date; vendor lead time longer than expected
risks.mitigation: Place catalyst order at least 12 months ahead; specify delivery 4 weeks before loading; include LDs
risks.contingency: Expedite shipping; delay catalyst loading and commissioning sequence

risks.title: Methanol storage permit delay
risks.description: Regulatory permit for methanol storage tanks delayed, preventing product storage and throughput
risks.early_warning_signals: Permit application not submitted by Phase 2; regulatory authority requesting additional information
risks.mitigation: Engage permit consultant early; submit complete application with all required drawings and studies
risks.contingency: Temporary storage arrangement; phased permit for reduced capacity

risks.title: Environmental clearance delayed
risks.description: Environmental clearance approval delayed beyond anticipated timeline, pushing back construction start
risks.early_warning_signals: EIA submission incomplete; public hearing objections; forest/wildlife clearance triggered
risks.mitigation: Start EIA early (Phase 1); engage reputable environmental consultant; community engagement program
risks.contingency: Alternative site with lower environmental sensitivity; appeal process

risks.title: Air emissions permit non-compliance risk
risks.description: Emission limits (NOx, SOx, particulates, CO, VOCs) cannot be met, preventing operation or requiring retrofit
risks.early_warning_signals: Emissions modelling shows limits exceeded; selective catalytic reduction (SCR) not sized correctly
risks.mitigation: Include emission control in design basis; model dispersion and set limits before design freeze
risks.contingency: Add or upgrade emission control; apply for revised limits

risks.title: Fire safety approval contingent on design changes
risks.description: Fire authority requires design changes after construction start, causing rework and delay
risks.early_warning_signals: Fire protection philosophy not reviewed with authority during FEED; layout changes requested
risks.mitigation: Pre-submit fire protection philosophy to authority during FEED; engage fire consultant
risks.contingency: Design changes during construction; increased fire water capacity

risks.title: HAZOP recommendations not closed before start-up
risks.description: Open HAZOP recommendations (especially safety-critical) prevent PSSR sign-off and start-up
risks.early_warning_signals: HAZOP recommendation close-out tracking below 80% at 3 months before planned start-up
risks.mitigation: Assign HAZOP recommendations with owners at close-out meeting; track monthly during construction
risks.contingency: Accelerated close-out program; defer non-critical items with documented risk acceptance

risks.title: Process safety incident during commissioning
risks.description: Syngas or methanol release during start-up operations due to human error or equipment failure
risks.early_warning_signals: Commissioning team not fully trained; safety systems not fully tested; procedures not followed
risks.mitigation: Mandatory PSSR; operator training and certification; permit-to-work system during commissioning
risks.contingency: Emergency response plan; site medical facility; mutual aid agreements

risks.title: Biomass storage fire or spontaneous combustion
risks.description: Self-heating of stored biomass leading to fire, especially with high moisture content or poor ventilation
risks.early_warning_signals: Temperature monitoring in piles showing increasing trend; musty odour; steam visible from pile
risks.mitigation: Limit pile size and storage duration; temperature monitoring system; fire water monitors
risks.contingency: Immediate stockpile turn; dedicated fire fighting plan for biomass

risks.title: Methanol toxicity exposure
risks.description: Operator or technician exposed to methanol during sampling, maintenance, or spill
risks.early_warning_signals: Methanol leak detected; PPE non-compliance observed; area gas monitoring alarm
risks.mitigation: Fixed gas detection; mandatory PPE; training on methanol hazards; double-block-and-bleed on sample points
risks.contingency: First aid/medical treatment protocol; methanol-specific PPE stations

risks.title: EPC contractor performance failure
risks.description: EPC contractor fails to deliver on schedule or within budget due to inadequate resourcing or poor management
risks.early_warning_signals: Monthly progress below plan for 3+ consecutive months; key staff turnover; change order rate high
risks.mitigation: Rigorous contractor pre-qualification; milestone-based payment schedule; robust contract with LD and bonus
risks.contingency: Replace key contractor personnel; merge activities back to owner team; legal remedies

risks.title: Lack of qualified construction labour
risks.description: Insufficient skilled labour (welders, pipefitters, electricians) in project region, causing schedule delays
risks.early_warning_signals: Construction workforce ramp-up behind plan; high turnover rate; quality issues from unqualified workers
risks.mitigation: Preferential local hiring; contractor-mobilised workforce from other regions; on-the-job training
risks.contingency: Modular construction to reduce field labour; overtime/parallel shifts

risks.title: Ground conditions worse than assumed
risks.description: Unexpected soil/ground conditions requiring deeper foundations, piling, or soil remediation
risks.early_warning_signals: Geotechnical investigation not completed before foundation design; boreholes show variability
risks.mitigation: Complete thorough geotechnical survey early (Phase 2); include provisional sums for ground risk
risks.contingency: Design change to deeper foundations; additional piling; schedule float use

risks.title: Equipment damage during shipment
risks.description: Major equipment (gasifier, columns, reactor) damaged during ocean or overland transport
risks.early_warning_signals: Transit insurance claims for minor items; reports of rough handling at port
risks.mitigation: Comprehensive marine and inland transit insurance; vendor to supervise loading and lashing; surveyor at discharge port
risks.contingency: Emergency repair at site; replacement order (6-12 month lead time impact)

risks.title: Cost overrun beyond contingency
risks.description: Project cost exceeds approved budget and contingency due to scope creep, escalation, or unforeseen conditions
risks.early_warning_signals: Monthly cost variance > 5% consecutively; change order rate exceeding budget allowance
risks.mitigation: Robust change management; budget contingency of 15-20%; escalation clause in EPC contract
risks.contingency: Additional financing facility; scope reduction; phased commissioning

risks.title: Financing not closed within schedule
risks.description: Project financing not finalised by FID, delaying construction start and increasing costs
risks.early_warning_signals: Lenders requesting additional due diligence items; offtake agreements not creditworthy
risks.mitigation: Engage financial advisor early; prepare complete due diligence package; secure strong offtake counterparties
risks.contingency: Bridge financing; phased equity injection; delay construction start

risks.title: Feedstock price escalation
risks.description: Feedstock costs increase above budget due to market demand, competing uses, or regulatory changes
risks.early_warning_signals: Biomass commodity index rising; new biomass power plants entering same catchment; regulatory changes on biomass use
risks.mitigation: Long-term price-locked feedstock contracts; diversified feedstock sources; price escalation pass-through in offtake
risks.contingency: Higher blending of cheaper feedstock grades; accept reduced margin

risks.title: Green methanol price collapse
risks.description: Market price for green methanol falls due to oversupply or cheaper alternatives, affecting project economics
risks.early_warning_signals: Global methanol capacity announcements; declining green premium; new entrants in market
risks.mitigation: Long-term offtake with floor price; cost-competitive production design; low-cost bioenergy feedstock strategy
risks.contingency: Alternative end-use markets; storage for price arbitrage; partial production curtailment

risks.title: Technology licensor insolvency
risks.description: Key technology licensor (gasifier, methanol synthesis) becomes insolvent, losing support and guarantees
risks.early_warning_signals: Licensor financial reports showing decline; staff turnover; delayed responses to technical queries
risks.mitigation: Financial health check before licence signing; escrow of license fees; multiple qualified licensors
risks.contingency: Technology substitution (6-12 month schedule impact); alternative support from competitor

risks.title: Offtake counterparty default
risks.description: Offtake buyer fails to take contracted volumes or pay, leaving product unsold
risks.early_warning_signals: Offtaker financial difficulties; late payments on other contracts; changing strategy
risks.mitigation: Credit check of offtaker; parent company guarantee; diversify offtake across multiple buyers
risks.contingency: Spot market sales; temporary storage at site; find alternative offtaker

risks.title: Wastewater treatment non-compliance
risks.description: Wastewater from process or utilities fails to meet discharge or zero-liquid-discharge standards
risks.early_warning_signals: Wastewater analysis showing elevated COD, phenols, or metals; WWTP not fully commissioned
risks.mitigation: Design WWTP based on conservative effluent estimates; zero-liquid-discharge if required by permit
risks.contingency: Additional treatment step; trucking to external treatment facility

risks.title: Ash/char disposal site not approved
risks.description: Disposal site for gasifier ash and char not identified or approved, causing storage and compliance issues
risks.early_warning_signals: Ash characterisation showing hazardous characteristics; no disposal agreement in place
risks.mitigation: Ash characterisation early in project; identify disposal sites; explore ash utilisation (cement, construction)
risks.contingency: On-site temporary storage; off-site hazardous waste disposal vendor

risks.title: Public opposition to biomass plant
risks.description: Local community opposition due to dust, odour, traffic, or emissions concerns delaying permits or construction
risks.early_warning_signals: Public hearing objections; local press coverage negative; community group formation
risks.mitigation: Community engagement program from Phase 1; transparent communication; local benefit sharing
risks.contingency: Additional odour suppression; truck routing changes; community compensation package

risks.title: Air separation unit (ASU) delay
risks.description: If oxygen-blown gasification selected, ASU delivery or performance delays impact overall schedule
risks.early_warning_signals: ASU order placed late; vendor with limited biomass gasification ASU experience; logistics complex
risks.mitigation: Order ASU early (Phase 3); performance guarantee for oxygen purity and power consumption
risks.contingency: Third-party oxygen supply agreement; temporary liquid oxygen backup

risks.title: Syngas compressor failure during commissioning
risks.description: Syngas compressor (reciprocating or centrifugal) experiences issues during run-in, delaying loop start-up
risks.early_warning_signals: Vibration during solo run-in high; seal system issues; lubrication system not validated
risks.mitigation: Factory acceptance test witnessed; thorough site pre-commissioning; compressor OEM technician on-site
risks.contingency: Spare rotor/valves; OEM hotline support

risks.title: DCS/SCADA integration issues
risks.description: Control system integration with multiple licensor packages (gasifier, cleanup, methanol reactor) problematic
risks.early_warning_signals: Interface definition incomplete; licensor packages have proprietary control systems not fully integrated
risks.mitigation: Define DCS interfaces in FEED; single DCS supplier; require licensor packages with open communication protocol
risks.contingency: Additional interface gateways; extended commissioning schedule

risks.title: Biomass feeding system plugging
risks.description: Biomass feeding system (lock hoppers, screw feeders, pneumatic conveying) experiences plugging or bridging
risks.early_warning_signals: Feeder torque high; flow rate fluctuations; pressure fluctuations at gasifier inlet
risks.mitigation: Design feeding system for feedstock variability; multiple feed points; bridging detection instrumentation
risks.contingency: Mechanical agitators/rappers; steam lances; manual rodding procedure

risks.title: Pre-commissioning schedule compression
risks.description: Commissioning schedule not achievable within original timeline due to late mechanical completion of one or more systems
risks.early_warning_signals: Construction schedule slippage > 10%; punch list growing; system handovers delayed
risks.mitigation: Early start of pre-commissioning on completed systems; phased turnover; additional commissioning staff
risks.contingency: Parallel systems commissioning; overtime; defer non-critical systems to ensure critical path

risks.title: Oxygen supply interruption
risks.description: If air separation unit supply fails or third-party oxygen is interrupted, gasifier cannot operate at design capacity
risks.early_warning_signals: ASU maintenance overdue; vendor reliability reports; single source oxygen supply
risks.mitigation: Liquid oxygen backup storage; dual-train ASU for large plants; air-blown operation as fallback
risks.contingency: Turndown to air-blown mode; reduced production until oxygen restored

risks.title: Regulatory change on biomass sourcing
risks.description: New regulations restrict or prohibit certain biomass sources (e.g., agricultural residue burning bans, forest residue restrictions)
risks.early_warning_signals: Policy announcements on biomass use; changes in renewable energy directives; new sustainability criteria
risks.mitigation: Diversify feedstock sources; monitor policy developments; engage with industry associations
risks.contingency: Switch to alternative feedstock types; import feedstock from wider region

risks.title: Pressure systems inspection delay
risks.description: Statutory inspection and certification of pressure vessels and piping delayed, preventing start-up
risks.early_warning_signals: Inspection authority not engaged early; documentation package incomplete; third-party inspection backlog
risks.mitigation: Engage inspection authority early in construction; prepare documentation package per checklist
risks.contingency: Expedited inspection request; external inspection agency engagement

risks.title: Warranty claims management inadequate
risks.description: Warranty defects not properly documented or claimed within warranty period, causing additional cost to owner
risks.early_warning_signals: Warranty claim log not maintained; defects not formally notified to contractor; warranty expiry approaching
risks.mitigation: Establish warranty tracking system at IAC; train operations team to identify and document defects
risks.contingency: Negotiated settlement with contractor post-warranty

risks.title: Utility supply interruption (power, water)
risks.description: Grid power failure or water supply disruption causes plant shutdown or production loss
risks.early_warning_signals: Grid reliability reports for site location; water availability studies show seasonal shortage
risks.mitigation: Emergency generator for critical loads; raw water storage pond; dual grid feed if available
risks.contingency: Production curtailment; water trucking for short-term shortage

risks.title: Gasifier uptime below target
risks.description: Gasifier availability lower than design target due to refractory wear, slagging, or feeding issues
risks.early_warning_signals: Gasifier forced outage frequency increasing; turnaround intervals reducing; refractory inspection showing wear
risks.mitigation: Preventive maintenance schedule; spare refractory inventory; feedstock blending to reduce slagging
risks.contingency: Planned maintenance optimisation; spare gasifier vessel for large plants (parallel trains)

risks.title: Performance test fails guarantee metrics
risks.description: One or more performance guarantees (capacity, consumption, purity, emissions) not met during 72-hour test
risks.early_warning_signals: Pre-test data shows specific consumption higher than guarantee; catalyst activity below expected
risks.mitigation: Pre-test optimisation runs; ensure all systems stable before test; defined acceptance criteria in contract
risks.contingency: Troubleshooting and retest (30-day delay); negotiate revised guarantees with LD

risks.title: Technology integration incompatibility
risks.description: Gasifier, syngas cleanup, and methanol synthesis technologies not fully compatible at process interface
risks.early_warning_signals: Interface definition incomplete in FEED; licensor data not integrated; pilot data not available
risks.mitigation: Single licensor for integrated solution if available; rigorous interface definition; pilot plant testing
risks.contingency: Additional buffer vessels/conditioning steps; technology substitution

risks.title: Project scope creep from regulatory requirements
risks.description: Additional requirements from regulatory authorities (additional emission control, monitoring, reporting) increase cost and schedule
risks.early_warning_signals: Regulator requests for additional studies; evolving regulatory framework; public consultation raising new issues
risks.mitigation: Engage regulator early; conservative design basis exceeding minimum requirements; proactive community engagement
risks.contingency: Budget contingency for regulatory add-ons; schedule float for permit rework

risks.title: Methanol quality fails IMPCA spec
risks.description: Product methanol fails to meet IMPCA specification for key parameters (ethanol, acetone, permanganate time, water)
risks.early_warning_signals: Lab analysis showing impurities approaching spec; column performance declining; crude methanol composition off-spec
risks.mitigation: Inline GC analyser; three-column distillation; product blending capability with on-spec methanol
risks.contingency: Re-processing through columns; temporary spec relaxation agreement with offtaker

risks.title: Electrical approvals delayed
risks.description: CEIG or equivalent electrical safety approval delayed, preventing power supply to the plant
risks.early_warning_signals: Electrical installation incomplete; testing documentation not ready; inspector availability
risks.mitigation: Engage electrical inspector early; complete all testing before applying; pre-submission review
risks.contingency: Temporary power supply for commissioning; phased approval

risks.title: Steam system chemistry not achieved
risks.description: Boiler feed water and steam purity not meeting turbine or process requirements, delaying steam-dependent commissioning
risks.early_warning_signals: Water analysis showing silica, hardness, or conductivity above target; water treatment plant issues
risks.mitigation: Commission water treatment plant early; add polishing step; operator training on water chemistry
risks.contingency: Temporary chemical dosing; external demin water supply

risks.title: Feedstock logistics disruption
risks.description: Transport of biomass from source to plant disrupted due to weather, road conditions, or transport availability
risks.early_warning_signals: Monsoon season approaching; road quality reports; transport contractor unreliable
risks.mitigation: Covered storage sufficient for 2-3 months; multiple transport routes; in-plant stockpile management
risks.contingency: Alternative transport modes; temporary mobile dryer for wet feedstock

risks.title: Performance guarantee run schedule conflict
risks.description: Time window for 72-hour performance test conflicts with catalyst age, market conditions, or obligated offtake delivery
risks.early_warning_signals: Schedule shows commissioning and first product delivery overlapping; offtaker delivery obligation imminent
risks.mitigation: Schedule 4-week window between first methanol and performance test; interim product storage
risks.contingency: Delayed performance test; interim product acceptance by offtaker

risks.title: ISCC/RSB sustainability certification failure
risks.description: Green methanol sustainability certification under ISCC EU, RSB, or equivalent is denied or delayed due to insufficient chain-of-custody documentation, GHG calculation errors, or feedstock sustainability non-compliance — preventing sale of product as certified green methanol
risks.early_warning_signals: GHG calculation not reviewed by certification body by end of Phase 3; chain-of-custody documentation gaps identified in pre-audit
risks.mitigation: Engage certification consultant early; implement ISCC/RSB-mandated mass balance system from commissioning; conduct internal pre-audit 3 months before first production
risks.contingency: Sell uncertified product as technical-grade methanol at reduced margin while remediation is underway; fast-track corrective action plan with certification body

risks.title: Wastewater treatment and discharge non-compliance
risks.description: Process wastewater from methanol production (containing methanol, higher alcohols, organic acids, catalyst fines) exceeds discharge consent limits, risking regulatory penalties, production curtailment, or costly off-site disposal
risks.early_warning_signals: Wastewater treatment plant design not integrated early in FEED; discharge consent conditions more stringent than design assumptions
risks.mitigation: Integrate wastewater treatment design into FEED with adequate contingency; pilot-test treatment with representative process wastewater during commissioning; secure discharge consent with conservative limits
risks.contingency: Contract off-site wastewater treatment services for non-compliant streams; install additional polishing treatment (activated carbon, membrane) as retrofit

risks.title: Methanol synthesis catalyst supply disruption or quality failure
risks.description: Copper-based methanol synthesis catalyst is delayed, unavailable from primary supplier, or fails to meet performance guarantees — delaying catalyst loading and jeopardising commissioning timeline
risks.early_warning_signals: Catalyst PO placed less than 12 months before commissioning start; single-source supply with no qualified alternative
risks.mitigation: Place catalyst order at least 12 months before commissioning; qualify at least two catalyst suppliers; include catalyst performance guarantees in purchase contract with sampling protocol
risks.contingency: Use interim catalyst from alternative supplier at reduced performance; modify commissioning sequence to delay catalyst-dependent steps; fast-track alternative supplier qualification

risks.title: Feedstock moisture variability exceeding gasifier design envelope
risks.description: Seasonal or supplier-driven feedstock moisture variation exceeds the gasifier's design moisture tolerance, causing reduced cold gas efficiency, increased tar formation, and potential refractory damage from thermal cycling
risks.early_warning_signals: Feedstock moisture monitoring not established early; moisture spikes > 30% not mitigated by drying capacity
risks.mitigation: Design drying system with 20% capacity buffer above expected worst-case moisture; maintain covered storage with active moisture monitoring; blend high-moisture and low-moisture feedstocks
risks.contingency: Reduce gasifier throughput to accommodate higher moisture; supplement with drier alternative feedstock; install temporary additional drying capacity
